an8.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Uttaro Mahisavatthusmiṃ viharati Saṃkheyyake pabbate Dhavajālikāyaṃ.
an8.8:1.2: Tatra kho āyasmā Uttaro bhikkhū āmantesi . . . pe . . . .
an8.8:1.3: Sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.8:1.4: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.8:1.5: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.8:1.6: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hotī ti. 3.
an8.8:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Vessavaṇo mahārājā uttarāya disāya dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ gacchati kenaci-d-eva karaṇīyena.
an8.8:2.2: Assosi kho Vessavaṇo mahārājā āyasmato Uttarassa Mahisavatthusmiṃ Saṃkheyyake pabbate Dhavajālikāyaṃ bhikkhunaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desentassa:
an8.8:2.3: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.8:2.4: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti;
an8.8:2.5: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.8:2.6: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hotī ti. 4.
an8.8:3.1: Atha kho Vessavaṇo mahārājā seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Mahisavatthusmiṃ Saṃkheyyake pabbate Dhavajālikāyaṃ antarahito devesu Tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.
an8.8:3.2: Atha kho Vessavaṇo mahārājā yena Sakko devānam indo ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Sakkaṃ devānam indaṃ etad avoca
an8.8:3.4: eso āyasmā Uttaro Mahisavatthusmiṃ Saṃkheyyake pabbate Dhavajālikāyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
an8.8:3.5: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.8:4.1: Atha kho Sakko devānam indo seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva devesu Tāvatiṃsesu antarahito Mahisavatthusmiṃ Saṃkheyyake pabbate Dhavajālikāyaṃ āyasmato Uttarassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
an8.8:4.2: Atha kho Sakko devānam indo yenāyasmā Uttaro ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Uttaraṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Sakko devānam indo āyasmantaṃ Uttaraṃ etad avoca
an8.8:5.1: ‘saccaṃ kira bhante āyasmā Uttaro bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desesi:
an8.8:5.2: sādhāvuso bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.8:5.7: ‘Kiṃ pan' idaṃ bhante āyasmato Uttarassa sakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ udāhu tassa Bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassā' ti? 6.
an8.8:5.8: ‘Tena hi devānam inda upaman te karissāmi,
an8.8:5.9: upamāya pi idh' ekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
an8.8:6.1: Seyyathā pi devānam inda gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahādhaññarāsi,
an8.8:6.3: kācehi pi piṭakehi pi ucchaṅgehi pi añjalīhi pi.
an8.8:6.4: Yo nu kho devānam inda taṃ mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ puccheyya:
an8.8:6.5: kuto imaṃ dhaññaṃ āharathā ti? Kathaṃ vyākaramāno nu kho devānam inda so mahājanakāyo sammā vyākaramāno vyākareyyā' ti?
an8.8:6.6: ‘Amumhā mahādhaññarāsimhā āharāmā ti kho bhante so mahājanakāyo sammā vyākaramāno vyākareyyā' ti. ‘Evam
an8.8:6.7: eva kho devānam inda yaṃ kiñci subhāsitaṃ, sabban taṃ tassa Bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an8.8:6.8: tato upādāy' upādāya mayañ c' aññe ca bhaṇāmā' ti. 7.
an8.8:7.3: yaṃ kiñci subhāsitaṃ, sabban taṃ tassa Bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an8.8:7.4: tato upādāy' upādāya mayaṃ c' aññe ca bhaṇāmā ti.
an8.8:7.5: Ekam idaṃ bhante Uttara samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate acirapakkante Devadatte.
an8.8:7.6: Tatra kho Bhagavā Devadattaṃ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi:
an8.8:8.1: Sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.8:8.2: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ . . .
an8.8:8.5: Aṭṭhahi bhikkhave asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
an8.8:8.14: pāpamittatāya bhikkhave abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
an8.8:8.15: Imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinna citto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
an8.8:9.1: Sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya vihareyya,
an8.8:10.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya vihareyya,
an8.8:11.1: Yaṃ hi 'ssa bhikkhave uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
an8.8:11.2: Yaṃ hi' ssa bhikkhave uppannaṃ alābhaṃ . . .
an8.8:11.8: uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
an8.8:11.9: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya vihareyya,
an8.8:12.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:-- 9.
an8.8:12.9: uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya viharissāmā ti. Evaṃ
an8.8:13.1: Yāvatā bhante Uttara manussesu catasso parisā:
an8.8:13.4: Uggaṇhātu bhante āyasmā Uttaro imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ,
an8.8:13.5: pariyāpuṇātu bhante āyasmā Uttaro imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ,
an8.8:13.6: dhāretu bhante āyasmā Uttaro imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ.
an8.8:13.7: Atthasaṃhito ayaṃ bhante dhammapariyāyo ādibrahmacariyiko ti. 1.
